method: Each oracle is wrapped in AssetPinnedOracle rooted at the capsule and called from a HOSTILE working directory -- the exact condition that makes PyTDC's relative, lazily loaded pickle raise into a bare except and return default_property 0.0.
finding: drd2 FAILED the control at all_zero=True, 0/6 references agreeing, 1 distinct value. AssetPinnedOracle was correct; the capsule simply did not CONTAIN drd2_current.pkl, so the pinned directory had no asset to load. gsk3b passed because its pickle is in the capsule; jnk3 passed because it loads EAGERLY at construction and caches on the instance, so it never consults the filesystem at call time.
resolution: Constructed drd2 and jnk3 with the working directory set to the capsule so TDC's relative download landed there. All three then pass from a hostile cwd.
blocking_caveat: The capsule is gitignored, so these assets are LOCAL-ONLY. The already-deployed compose-pmo-seed-weighting image was built when only gsk3b_current.pkl existed, so drd2/jnk3 require a REDEPLOY before they can be launched.
